root_cause.valid_route_identifier: 10-Q is an exact official filing type already allowed by the reviewed source policy, not a free numeric claim.
root_cause.validator_conflation: The same global no-digit narrative validator was applied to thesis atoms and to the WWC evidence-route field, so an official document identifier was rejected as numeric prose.
root_cause.safe_fix_boundary: Only exact policy-qualified document identifiers may be ignored by the numeric-surface scan in evidence_route; percentages, dates, amounts, years and unregistered digit strings must still fail closed.

business_content_observation.thesis: Management product profitability remains an unaudited product-scope assertion and is not presented as audited product profit.
business_content_observation.mechanism: Missing price, volume and configuration decomposition keeps the product-to-segment and product-to-company profit bridge not inferable.
business_content_observation.counterargument: Same-basis company gross-margin contraction is used only as a company-level counter observation and is explicitly not attributed to one product or segment.
business_content_observation.what_would_change: The model asks for the next same-fiscal-quarter company gross-margin observation from an official earnings release or 10-Q and binds the current-period threshold; this may weaken the counter observation but does not itself establish the missing product profit bridge.

known_boundary: R5 contains six complete provider responses and three accepted natural fragments with no observed financial L1, but it did not form a terminal Judgment under its bound contract and cannot be promoted.
